_comment: One entry for the awesome-dsh-plugin curated registry (dshmarket's install source). Schema copied from a live entry of the registry snapshot shipped with dsh-find-plugin: {name, owner, url, category, description{en,zh}, install, added}. Replace <owner> with the GitHub account that publishes the repo, then insert this object into the registry's `plugins` array and open a PR.
name: dsh-watermark

description.en: Batch watermark removal: corner marks, arbitrary positions, light/dark/coloured, semi-transparent and tiled marks, changing only the watermark's own pixels. Learns a reusable alpha/colour signature from a marked/clean pair and then inverts the overlay exactly instead of painting over it.
description.zh: 批量去水印：角标、任意位置、深浅/彩色/半透明/平铺水印都能处理，且只改水印像素。可从"带水印/无水印"图对学出可复用的 alpha/颜色签名，之后精确反解而不是涂抹。
